notes.text:
This update for pam fixes the following issue

- CVE-2026-54411: timing discrepancy in the pam_userdb module's plaintext-password comparison (bsc#1268290).

notes.text: Linux-PAM through 1.7.2 contains an observable timing discrepancy (CWE-208) in the pam_userdb module's plaintext-password comparison path in modules/pam_userdb/pam_userdb.c that allows a local or network-adjacent attacker able to repeatedly drive authentication through a calling service to recover the plaintext password of a target account by measuring response-timing differences.
